name: Open YouTube Growth Radar
honestScope: A creator dashboard that ranks videos against each channel's own baseline, explains patterns, and generates improved publishing assets.
gaps: Needs persistent channel history and watchlist scheduling
Outlier scoring is application-side and cannot imply a universal market corpus
YouTube quota, OAuth, and publishing policy constraints must be visible
notes: Second-priority new application. Extend Open-VidIQ rather than starting from an unrelated codebase.
